library(dplyr)
library(magrittr)
library(pROC)
library(ggplot2)






# 5.1. Import metadata & predictions


data_dir    <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/data"
results_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/results"

patient_info_with_folds <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "metadata_df_with_folds.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# All prediction files
classifier_files <- tibble(
  classifier = c(
    "Full LASSO",
    "3-feature LASSO",
    "1-feature LASSO",
    "FABP4",
    "ISG15"
  ),
  csv = c(
    "lassoRF_preds.csv",
    "lassoRF_preds_n3.csv",
    "lassoRF_preds_n1.csv",
    "lassoRF_preds_FABP4.csv",
    "lassoRF_preds_ISG15.csv"
  ),
  suffix = c(
    "",
    "n3",
    "n1",
    "FABP4",
    "ISG15"
  )
)

# Import all five prediction files
pred_list <- classifier_files %>%
  mutate(
    preds = lapply(csv, function(f) {
      read.csv(
        file.path(results_dir, f),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ) %>%
        mutate(
          LRTI_adjudication = factor(
            LRTI_adjudication,
            levels = c("No Evidence", "Definite")
          )
        ) %>%
        inner_join(
          patient_info_with_folds %>%
            select(sample_name, fold),
          by = "sample_name"
        )
    })
  )






# 5.2. AUC helper function


output_auc_roc <- function(preds_df, output_suffix) {

  # Per-fold AUC
  auc_df <- preds_df %>%
    group_by(fold) %>%
    summarize({
      roc_obj <- pROC::roc(
        response = factor(
          LRTI_adjudication,
          levels = c("No Evidence", "Definite")
        ),
        predictor = pred,
        direction = "<"
      )

      ci_vals <- pROC::ci.auc(roc_obj)

      tibble(
        auc = as.numeric(roc_obj$auc),
        auc_lower = ci_vals[1],
        auc_upper = ci_vals[3]
      )
    }, .groups = "drop")

  # Save per-fold AUC
  write.csv(
    auc_df,
    file.path(
      results_dir,
      paste0(
        "cv_auc",
        ifelse(output_suffix == "", "", paste0("_", output_suffix)),
        ".csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # Pooled ROC
  pooled_roc <- pROC::roc(
    response = factor(
      preds_df$LRTI_adjudication,
      levels = c("No Evidence", "Definite")
    ),
    predictor = preds_df$pred,
    direction = "<"
  )

  # Pooled DeLong 95% CI
  ci_auc <- pROC::ci.auc(pooled_roc)

  pooled_summary <- data.frame(
    auc   = as.numeric(ci_auc[2]),
    lower = ci_auc[1],
    upper = ci_auc[3]
  )

  # Save pooled AUC
  write.csv(
    pooled_summary,
    file.path(
      results_dir,
      paste0(
        "pooled_auc",
        ifelse(output_suffix == "", "", paste0("_", output_suffix)),
        ".csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  list(
    fold_auc = auc_df,
    pooled = pooled_summary
  )
}






# 5.3. Run all five classifiers


auc_results <- pred_list %>%
  mutate(
    results = Map(
      output_auc_roc,
      preds,
      suffix
    )
  )

# Full LASSO objects retained for downstream sections
merged_preds <- pred_list$preds[[1]]

auc_lassoRF <- auc_results$results[[1]]$fold_auc

# Print full LASSO AUC
print(auc_lassoRF)






# 5.4. Full LASSO summary


ci_auc <- read.csv(
  file.path(results_dir, "pooled_auc.csv")
)

message(
  "Full LASSO AUC: ",
  round(ci_auc$auc, 2),
  " (95% CI: ",
  round(ci_auc$lower, 2),
  "–",
  round(ci_auc$upper, 2),
  ")"
)






# 5.5. Forest plots


# Gene-only forest plot
# Includes all five classifiers, including 1-feature LASSO

forest_data_gene <- auc_results %>%
  transmute(
    classifier,
    auc   = sapply(results, function(x) x$pooled$auc),
    lower = sapply(results, function(x) x$pooled$lower),
    upper = sapply(results, function(x) x$pooled$upper)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    classifier = factor(
      classifier,
      levels = c(
        "ISG15",
        "FABP4",
        "1-feature LASSO",
        "3-feature LASSO",
        "Full LASSO"
      )
    )
  )

print(forest_data_gene)


# Gene-only forest plot
forest_plot_gene <- ggplot(
  forest_data_gene,
  aes(y = classifier)
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = auc),
    size = 4,
    shape = 18
  ) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(
      xmin = lower,
      xmax = upper
    ),
    height = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = upper + 0.03,
      label = sprintf(
        "%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
        auc,
        lower,
        upper
      )
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 1.15),
    breaks = seq(0.5, 1.0, 0.1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "AUROC comparison across gene classifiers",
    subtitle = "Point estimates with 95% DeLong confidence intervals",
    x = "AUROC",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(
      family = "Helvetica",
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 14
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      face = "plain",
      size = 11
    )
  )

print(forest_plot_gene)

ggsave(
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "forest_plot_gene_classifiers.pdf"
  ),
  forest_plot_gene,
  width = 10,
  height = 5
)

write.csv(
  forest_data_gene,
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "forest_data_gene_classifiers.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)






# 5.5b. Forest Plot – Gene + Protein Classifiers

# 5.7. Gene vs protein ROC curves for individual biomarkers


# Protein results directory
prot_results_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/results"


# Function to create gene vs protein ROC plot
make_biomarker_roc_plot <- function(
  biomarker_name,
  gene_file,
  protein_file,
  output_file
) {

  # Read gene predictions
  gene_preds <- read.csv(
    file.path(results_dir, gene_file),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Read protein predictions
  protein_preds <- read.csv(
    file.path(prot_results_dir, protein_file),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Ensure consistent factor levels
  gene_preds$LRTI_adjudication <- factor(
    gene_preds$LRTI_adjudication,
    levels = c("No Evidence", "Definite")
  )

  protein_preds$LRTI_adjudication <- factor(
    protein_preds$LRTI_adjudication,
    levels = c("No Evidence", "Definite")
  )


  # Compute ROC objects
  roc_gene <- pROC::roc(
    response = gene_preds$LRTI_adjudication,
    predictor = gene_preds$pred,
    direction = "<",
    ci = TRUE
  )

  roc_protein <- pROC::roc(
    response = protein_preds$LRTI_adjudication,
    predictor = protein_preds$pred,
    direction = "<",
    ci = TRUE
  )


  # Prepare ROC data frames
  roc_gene_df <- data.frame(
    specificity = roc_gene$specificities,
    sensitivity = roc_gene$sensitivities,
    classifier = "Gene"
  ) %>%
    arrange(specificity, sensitivity)

  roc_protein_df <- data.frame(
    specificity = roc_protein$specificities,
    sensitivity = roc_protein$sensitivities,
    classifier = "Protein"
  ) %>%
    arrange(specificity, sensitivity)

  roc_combined <- bind_rows(
    roc_gene_df,
    roc_protein_df
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      classifier = factor(
        classifier,
        levels = c("Gene", "Protein")
      )
    )


  # Prepare confidence interval data
  ci_gene <- pROC::ci.se(
    roc_gene,
    specificities = seq(0, 1, 0.01)
  )

  ci_protein <- pROC::ci.se(
    roc_protein,
    specificities = seq(0, 1, 0.01)
  )


  ci_gene_df <- data.frame(
    specificity       = as.numeric(rownames(ci_gene)),
    sensitivity_lower = ci_gene[, 1],
    sensitivity_upper = ci_gene[, 3],
    classifier        = "Gene"
  ) %>%
    arrange(specificity)

  ci_protein_df <- data.frame(
    specificity       = as.numeric(rownames(ci_protein)),
    sensitivity_lower = ci_protein[, 1],
    sensitivity_upper = ci_protein[, 3],
    classifier        = "Protein"
  ) %>%
    arrange(specificity)

  ci_combined <- bind_rows(
    ci_gene_df,
    ci_protein_df
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      classifier = factor(
        classifier,
        levels = c("Gene", "Protein")
      )
    )


  # Pooled AUC values and 95% CIs
  auc_ci_gene <- pROC::ci.auc(roc_gene)
  auc_ci_protein <- pROC::ci.auc(roc_protein)


  # Legend labels
  classifier_labels <- c(
    "Gene" = sprintf(
      "Gene: AUC = %.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
      auc_ci_gene[2],
      auc_ci_gene[1],
      auc_ci_gene[3]
    ),
    "Protein" = sprintf(
      "Protein: AUC = %.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
      auc_ci_protein[2],
      auc_ci_protein[1],
      auc_ci_protein[3]
    )
  )


  # Create ROC plot
  roc_plot <- ggplot() +

    # Diagonal reference line
    geom_abline(
      intercept = 1,
      slope = -1,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey80",
      linewidth = 0.8,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +

    # Confidence interval ribbons
    geom_ribbon(
      data = ci_combined,
      aes(
        x = specificity,
        ymin = sensitivity_lower,
        ymax = sensitivity_upper,
        fill = classifier,
        group = classifier
      ),
      alpha = 0.12
    ) +

    # ROC curves
    geom_line(
      data = roc_combined,
      aes(
        x = specificity,
        y = sensitivity,
        color = classifier,
        group = classifier
      ),
      linewidth = 1
    ) +

    # Axes
    scale_x_reverse(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
      labels = sprintf("%.1f", seq(0, 1, 0.2))
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
      limits = c(0, 1)
    ) +

    # Colors
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Gene" = "#0072B2",
        "Protein" = "#009E73"
      ),
      labels = classifier_labels,
      name = NULL
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Gene" = "#0072B2",
        "Protein" = "#009E73"
      ),
      name = NULL,
      guide = "none"
    ) +

    coord_fixed() +

    # Labels
    labs(
      title = paste0(biomarker_name, ": gene vs protein"),
      x = "Specificity",
      y = "Sensitivity"
    ) +

    # Theme
    theme_classic(
      base_size = 12,
      base_family = "Arial"
    ) +

    theme(
      text = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 12,
        face = "plain"
      ),
      axis.text = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 12,
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 12,
        face = "plain"
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 12,
        face = "plain",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      legend.text = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 12,
        face = "plain"
      ),
      legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "lines"),
      legend.position = c(0.62, 0.18),
      legend.background = element_rect(
        fill = "white",
        color = NA
      )
    )


  # Print plot
  print(roc_plot)


  # Export as editable vector PDF
  ggsave(
    file.path(results_dir, output_file),
    roc_plot,
    width = 6.5,
    height = 6.5,
    device = cairo_pdf,
    bg = "white"
  )


  # DeLong test
  delong_test <- pROC::roc.test(
    roc_gene,
    roc_protein,
    method = "delong"
  )


  # Print AUC summaries
  message(
    biomarker_name,
    " Gene AUC: ",
    round(auc_ci_gene[2], 2),
    " (95% CI: ",
    round(auc_ci_gene[1], 2),
    "–",
    round(auc_ci_gene[3], 2),
    ")"
  )

  message(
    biomarker_name,
    " Protein AUC: ",
    round(auc_ci_protein[2], 2),
    " (95% CI: ",
    round(auc_ci_protein[1], 2),
    "–",
    round(auc_ci_protein[3], 2),
    ")"
  )

  message(
    biomarker_name,
    " Gene vs Protein DeLong p-value: ",
    signif(delong_test$p.value, 3)
  )


  # Return results
  invisible(
    list(
      roc_gene = roc_gene,
      roc_protein = roc_protein,
      auc_gene = auc_ci_gene,
      auc_protein = auc_ci_protein,
      delong = delong_test
    )
  )
}

# 5.8. Gene / Protein adjudication plots


# Protein results directory
prot_results_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/results"


# Helper function to make gene vs protein prediction-shift plot

make_switch_plot <- function(
    classifier_name,
    gene_filename,
    output_filename
) {

  # Read gene predictions
  gene_preds <- read.csv(
    file.path(results_dir, gene_filename),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      sample_name,
      LRTI_adjudication,
      pred_gene = pred
    )

  # Read protein predictions
  prot_preds <- read.csv(
    file.path(prot_results_dir, gene_filename),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      patient_id,
      pred_prot = pred
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      patient_id = as.character(patient_id)
    )


  # Use metadata to connect gene sample_name to protein patient_id
  combined_preds <- gene_preds %>%
    left_join(
      metadata_df_with_folds %>%
        dplyr::select(
          sample_name,
          patient_id
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          patient_id = as.character(patient_id)
        ),
      by = "sample_name"
    ) %>%
    inner_join(
      prot_preds,
      by = "patient_id"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      switched = (pred_gene >= 0.5) != (pred_prot >= 0.5),
      LRTI_adjudication = factor(
        LRTI_adjudication,
        levels = c("Definite", "No Evidence")
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      sample_name,
      patient_id,
      LRTI_adjudication,
      pred_gene,
      pred_prot,
      switched
    )


  # Check that matching worked
  message(
    classifier_name,
    ": ",
    nrow(combined_preds),
    " matched patients"
  )

  message(
    classifier_name,
    ": ",
    sum(combined_preds$switched),
    " switched patients"
  )


  # Facet labels
  facet_labels <- c(
  "Definite" = "LRTI",
  "No Evidence" = "Control"
  )


  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(combined_preds) +

    # Non-switcher lines
    geom_segment(
      data = combined_preds %>%
        filter(!switched),
      aes(
        x = 1,
        xend = 2,
        y = pred_gene,
        yend = pred_prot
      ),
      color = "grey88",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +

    # Switcher lines
    geom_segment(
      data = combined_preds %>%
        filter(switched),
      aes(
        x = 1,
        xend = 2,
        y = pred_gene,
        yend = pred_prot
      ),
      color = "grey40",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +

    # Gene predictions
    geom_point(
      aes(
        x = 1,
        y = pred_gene,
        color = LRTI_adjudication
      ),
      size = 2.8,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +

    # Protein predictions
    geom_point(
      aes(
        x = 2,
        y = pred_prot,
        color = LRTI_adjudication
      ),
      size = 2.8,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    
    # Classification threshold
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0.5,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey40",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Definite" = "#D55E00",
        "No Evidence" = "#8B4789"
      ),
      breaks = c(
        "Definite",
        "No Evidence"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Definite" = "LRTI",
        "No Evidence" = "Control"
      )
    ) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("Gene", "Protein"),
      limits = c(0.7, 2.3)
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)
    ) +

    facet_wrap(
      ~LRTI_adjudication,
      ncol = 2,
      labeller = labeller(
        LRTI_adjudication = facet_labels
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "Prediction shift: gene vs protein (",
        classifier_name,
        ")"
      ),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Predicted LRTI probability"
    ) +

    theme_classic(
      base_size = 12,
      base_family = "Arial"
    ) +

    theme(
      text = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 12,
        face = "plain"
      ),
      axis.text = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 12,
        color = "black",
        face = "plain"
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 12,
        face = "plain"
      ),
      strip.text = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 12,
        face = "plain"
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 12,
        face = "plain",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      legend.position = "none"
    )


  # Display plot
  print(p)


  # Save PDF
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(results_dir, output_filename),
    plot = p,
    width = 6.5,
    height = 6.5,
    device = cairo_pdf,
    bg = "white"
  )


  # Return the data and plot
  invisible(
    list(
      plot = p,
      combined_preds = combined_preds,
      switched_patients = combined_preds %>%
        filter(switched)
    )
  )
}

# 5.9. Late Integration — Logistic Regression on Gene + Protein Probabilities


# Import Full LASSO gene predictions
gene_preds_full <- read.csv(
  file.path(results_dir, "lassoRF_preds.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Import Full LASSO protein predictions
prot_preds_full <- read.csv(
  file.path(
    "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/results",
    "lassoRF_preds.csv"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Match gene sample names to protein patient IDs using metadata
combined_preds <- metadata_df_with_folds %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_name,
    patient_id,
    LRTI_adjudication
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    gene_preds_full %>%
      dplyr::select(
        sample_name,
        pred_gene = pred
      ),
    by = "sample_name"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    prot_preds_full %>%
      dplyr::select(
        patient_id,
        pred_prot = pred
      ),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_name,
    patient_id,
    LRTI_adjudication,
    pred_gene,
    pred_prot
  )


# Check that the expected 105 patients were matched

message(
  "Matched patients for late integration: ",
  nrow(combined_preds)
)

if (nrow(combined_preds) != 105) {
  warning(
    "Expected 105 matched patients, but found ",
    nrow(combined_preds),
    "."
  )
}


# Apply logit transformation to both probability streams
# Regularize away from 0/1 first

n_trees <- 10000
epsilon <- 1 / n_trees

combined_preds_logit <- combined_preds %>%
  mutate(
    pred_gene_reg = pmax(
      pmin(pred_gene, 1 - epsilon),
      epsilon
    ),
    pred_prot_reg = pmax(
      pmin(pred_prot, 1 - epsilon),
      epsilon
    ),
    logit_gene = log(
      pred_gene_reg / (1 - pred_gene_reg)
    ),
    logit_prot = log(
      pred_prot_reg / (1 - pred_prot_reg)
    ),
    y = as.integer(
      LRTI_adjudication == "Definite"
    )
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    metadata_df_with_folds %>%
      dplyr::select(
        sample_name,
        fold
      ),
    by = "sample_name"
  )


# Fit integrated logistic regression per fold
# Train on 4 folds and predict on 1

integrated_preds <- lapply(
  sort(unique(combined_preds_logit$fold)),
  function(f) {

    train_df <- combined_preds_logit %>%
      filter(fold != f)

    test_df <- combined_preds_logit %>%
      filter(fold == f)

    logit_fit <- glm(
      y ~ logit_gene + logit_prot,
      data = train_df,
      family = binomial
    )

    data.frame(
      sample_name = test_df$sample_name,
      LRTI_adjudication = test_df$LRTI_adjudication,
      pred = predict(
        logit_fit,
        newdata = test_df,
        type = "response"
      ),
      fold = f
    )
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows()


# Compute integrated AUC

roc_integrated <- pROC::roc(
  response = factor(
    integrated_preds$LRTI_adjudication,
    levels = c("No Evidence", "Definite")
  ),
  predictor = integrated_preds$pred,
  direction = "<"
)

auc_integrated <- as.numeric(
  pROC::auc(roc_integrated)
)

ci_integrated <- pROC::ci.auc(
  roc_integrated,
  conf.level = 0.95
)

message(
  "Integrated AUC: ",
  round(auc_integrated, 3),
  " (95% CI: ",
  round(ci_integrated[1], 3),
  "–",
  round(ci_integrated[3], 3),
  ")"
)


# Compute Gene AUC

roc_gene <- pROC::roc(
  response = factor(
    combined_preds$LRTI_adjudication,
    levels = c("No Evidence", "Definite")
  ),
  predictor = combined_preds$pred_gene,
  direction = "<"
)

auc_gene <- as.numeric(
  pROC::auc(roc_gene)
)

ci_gene <- pROC::ci.auc(
  roc_gene,
  conf.level = 0.95
)

message(
  "Gene AUC: ",
  round(auc_gene, 3),
  " (95% CI: ",
  round(ci_gene[1], 3),
  "–",
  round(ci_gene[3], 3),
  ")"
)


# Compute Protein AUC

roc_prot <- pROC::roc(
  response = factor(
    combined_preds$LRTI_adjudication,
    levels = c("No Evidence", "Definite")
  ),
  predictor = combined_preds$pred_prot,
  direction = "<"
)

auc_prot <- as.numeric(
  pROC::auc(roc_prot)
)

ci_prot <- pROC::ci.auc(
  roc_prot,
  conf.level = 0.95
)

message(
  "Protein AUC: ",
  round(auc_prot, 3),
  " (95% CI: ",
  round(ci_prot[1], 3),
  "–",
  round(ci_prot[3], 3),
  ")"
)


# Compare all three models

auc_comparison <- data.frame(
  model = c(
    "Gene",
    "Protein",
    "Integrated"
  ),
  auc = c(
    auc_gene,
    auc_prot,
    auc_integrated
  ),
  auc_lower = c(
    ci_gene[1],
    ci_prot[1],
    ci_integrated[1]
  ),
  auc_upper = c(
    ci_gene[3],
    ci_prot[3],
    ci_integrated[3]
  )
)

print(auc_comparison)






# 5.10. DeLong Pairwise AUC Comparisons


# Align all three prediction sets by sample_name

delong_data <- combined_preds %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_name,
    LRTI_adjudication,
    pred_gene,
    pred_prot
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    integrated_preds %>%
      dplyr::select(
        sample_name,
        pred_integrated = pred
      ),
    by = "sample_name"
  )


# Response variable

response <- factor(
  delong_data$LRTI_adjudication,
  levels = c("No Evidence", "Definite")
)


# ROC objects

roc_gene <- pROC::roc(
  response = response,
  predictor = delong_data$pred_gene,
  direction = "<"
)

roc_prot <- pROC::roc(
  response = response,
  predictor = delong_data$pred_prot,
  direction = "<"
)

roc_integrated <- pROC::roc(
  response = response,
  predictor = delong_data$pred_integrated,
  direction = "<"
)


# Pairwise DeLong tests

delong_gene_vs_prot <- pROC::roc.test(
  roc_gene,
  roc_prot,
  method = "delong"
)

delong_gene_vs_integrated <- pROC::roc.test(
  roc_gene,
  roc_integrated,
  method = "delong"
)

delong_prot_vs_integrated <- pROC::roc.test(
  roc_prot,
  roc_integrated,
  method = "delong"
)


# Summary table

delong_results <- data.frame(
  comparison = c(
    "Gene vs Protein",
    "Gene vs Integrated",
    "Protein vs Integrated"
  ),
  auc_1 = round(
    c(
      as.numeric(roc_gene$auc),
      as.numeric(roc_gene$auc),
      as.numeric(roc_prot$auc)
    ),
    3
  ),
  auc_2 = round(
    c(
      as.numeric(roc_prot$auc),
      as.numeric(roc_integrated$auc),
      as.numeric(roc_integrated$auc)
    ),
    3
  ),
  z_statistic = round(
    c(
      delong_gene_vs_prot$statistic,
      delong_gene_vs_integrated$statistic,
      delong_prot_vs_integrated$statistic
    ),
    3
  ),
  p_value = signif(
    c(
      delong_gene_vs_prot$p.value,
      delong_gene_vs_integrated$p.value,
      delong_prot_vs_integrated$p.value
    ),
    2
  ),
  significant = c(
    delong_gene_vs_prot$p.value,
    delong_gene_vs_integrated$p.value,
    delong_prot_vs_integrated$p.value
  ) < 0.05
)

print(delong_results)


# Save DeLong results

write.csv(
  delong_results,
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "delong_auc_comparisons.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
